parole.significato: rectified spirit (spirit that has been purified to or close to the maximum concentration obtainable by using convention…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian спирт (spirt), from English spirit, from Latin spīritus.
Borrowed from Russian борка́н (borkán). See Latvian bur̃kā̃ns for further etymology. * (carrot, incentive): Semantic loan from English carrot (as in carrot and stick).
